entries.description: Built Module 17 (cnb/ui/config-io.js): JSON save with configName-derived filename and plan 4.11 created/modified stamping, load via CNBConfig.merge over defaults (open-keyed map sections replace) + validate; 31 unit tests (round-trip fidelity incl. custom-shapes config, malformed-file handling, render() UI on stub DOM) all passing (496 total); test page hosting Module 15 + Module 17 on shared config state; Playwright UAT driver cnb/uat/uat-config-io.mjs 19/19 checks passed (edit-save-reload-load round trip incl. real download capture, second-save timestamp behavior, malformed load).

Round-1 verification remediation. Final counts supersede the step-1 entry (which was logged before two later commits added tests): cnb-config-io-tests.js has 34 unit tests and the full suite is 498 passed / 0 failed (464 pre-existing + 34 new); legacy suite 240/240. Fixes: (a) map-section replacement guarded to plain objects (null/wrong-typed values keep merge defaults) + test; (b) render() save/load paths now invoke the host callback BEFORE redraw so the filename preview reflects the adopted (loaded) config + regression test; UAT re-run 19/19.

Built cnb/ui/config-export.js (Module 18): validate-then-export flow (CNBConfig.validate + exporter-side path-data check + filename derivability; blocked on errors, proceeds with warnings), .ly download named per meta.fileSuffix/meta.configName precedence, verbatim CNBLilypond.generate output. 25 unit tests in cnb/tests/cnb-config-export-tests.js (registered in run-tests.js; suite 523/523, legacy 240/240). Visual test page cnb/test-pages/test-config-export.html hosting Modules 13+15+18 on shared config. Playwright UAT cnb/uat/uat-config-export.mjs executing docs/session-sets/006-config-io-export-and-preview/s2-uat.md: 20/20 checks incl. Node-side byte-parity with direct generate() and editor-driven blocked/fixed flow.

Supersedes step 1 counts after extending the UAT surface: added the set-004 Palette Editor (Module 12) to cnb/test-pages/test-config-export.html and the UAT flow (Dark2 3-color preset -> cnb:register-color! shamrock-1b9e77 in Section A), and a .cnb-cex-status-blocked modifier class on the blocked status line. Final counts: 25 unit tests in cnb-config-export-tests.js, suite 523/523, legacy 240/240, UAT 22/22 (docs/session-sets/006-config-io-export-and-preview/s2-uat.md).

Supersedes step 2 counts after verification round 1 remediation: added the key=null used-shape parity pinning test (key-scoped rule referencing a pathless shape passes both validateForExport and CNBLilypond.generate; widened to keys=all both flag it). Final counts: 26 unit tests in cnb-config-export-tests.js, suite 524/524, legacy 240/240, UAT 22/22.
